description: This source file defines the 'FormattedDocument' class within the MigraDoc.Rendering namespace. It manages the formatting, pagination, headers, footers, and rendering information for a document, including handling page layout, section breaks, and header/footer formatting.

classes.name: FormattedDocument
classes.description: Represents a formatted document capable of pagination, header/footer formatting, and rendering information management within the MigraDoc rendering process.

classes.name: HeaderFooterPosition
classes.description: A struct used as a key for header/footer formatting dictionaries, combining section number and page position (First, Odd, Even).

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the document by performing line breaks and page breaks, initializing pagination, headers, and footers.

methods.name: GetRenderInfos
methods.description: Retrieves rendering information for a specific page.

methods.name: GetFormattedHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the formatted header for a specific page.

methods.name: GetFormattedFooter
methods.description: Retrieves the formatted footer for a specific page.

methods.name: FillNumPagesInfo
methods.description: Fills in total page count information after formatting.

methods.name: FillSectionPagesInfo
methods.description: Fills in section page count information after formatting a section.

methods.name: CalcContentRect
methods.description: Calculates the content rectangle for a given page based on section page setup.

methods.name: GetPageInfo
methods.description: Returns information about a specific page.

methods.name: GetNextArea
methods.description: Provides the next layout area for rendering content.

methods.name: ProbeNextArea
methods.description: Predicts the rectangle of the next layout area without advancing.

methods.name: InitFieldInfos
methods.description: Initializes field information for the current page.

methods.name: StoreRenderInfos
methods.description: Stores rendering information for the current page.

methods.name: CalcPageOrientation
methods.description: Determines page orientation based on section setup.

methods.name: CalcPageSize
methods.description: Calculates page size from section page setup.

methods.name: PositionHorizontally
methods.description: Positions content horizontally based on layout info and page setup.

methods.name: PositionVertically
methods.description: Positions content vertically based on layout info and page setup.

methods.name: NeedsEmptyPage
methods.description: Determines if an empty page should be inserted based on section start settings.

methods.name: InsertEmptyPage
methods.description: Inserts an empty page into the document pagination.

methods.name: PositionVerticallyToPage
methods.description: Positions content vertically relative to the page height.

methods.name: PositionVerticallyToMargin
methods.description: Positions content vertically relative to section margins.

methods.name: ChooseHeaderFooter
methods.description: Selects the appropriate header or footer based on page position and section settings.
